segments.text: Can you recommend any outdoor sporting activities for those who like to keep fit?
Yes. Bristol has a wide range of rock climbing opportunities on a variety of cliffs.
The Avon Gorge is a key historic British climbing site and the West Country's most famous cliff
and is unique in that it lies within the boundary of a major city and serves a large immediate population.
Although Bristol's relatively dry and mild climate favours outdoor climbing,
many people learn to climb by taking their first steps on indoor climbing walls.
Indoor walls are also useful for training and pushing performance levels, especially during winter time.
That sounds like fun. How can anyone get started?
Well, Bristol has a choice of climbing clubs that welcome new members, including beginners.
Joining a climbing club is an effective, sociable and traditional way for newcomers to get to learn the ropes.
Being guided by an experienced climber or undertaking a climbing course or employing a qualified instructor or mountain guide are proven ways to learn climbing.
Great. That's all we have time for today. Thank you, Gemma. There's certainly a lot to do in Bristol.
That's been very interesting and helpful. And thank you for coming into the studio.
